horizon_semantics: horizon_h spans h sessions IN TOTAL, the entry session counted as the first
secondary_outcome: mfe_atr_{h}d — MFE normalised by entry-session ATR
exit_policy: NONE — pure price potential. A trailing policy answers a different question and is a separate outcome family.
maturity: global market calendar; termination is a separate status
exposure: NOT_EXPOSED — no value, median, quantile or ranking may be read until SEQUENCE_GRAMMAR_V1 is frozen
